scope: 3 existing public poses only; no controller, trajectory selection or h-range change

momentum_sum_budget.states: zero + 17 basis + fixed mixed + same mixed in constant rotated coordinates

spin_columns: 2wheel + 8guide hinge axes/pivots and descendants from public body tree, analytic; no extra FK
wheel_and_guide_phases: all zero synthetic fixtures only; independent rates explicit, not assumed zero in mixed or basis

Q.convention: active extrinsic xyz: Q=Rz(0.2) Ry(-0.4) Rx(0.3), all B vectors/J axes transformed together

comparison.rule: component abs(a-b)<=abs_SI+rel*max(abs(a),abs(b)); H in kg*m^2/s, inertia in kg*m^2; algebra consistency only
comparison.SPD: symmetric locked inertia eigvals strictly positive; no tolerance relaxation

direct_sum: sum_i [I_i_B*(omega+Jrot_i*zdot) + (r_i-rG) cross m_i*((omega cross r_i + Jcom_i*zdot) - (omega cross rG + JG*zdot))]
matrix_prediction: I_locked*omega+A*zdot; symmetric common columns Ac=Aq*[1,1,1,1], Adelta=Aq*[0,1,0,1]
covariance: transform geometry/inertia/J/omega by Q with scalar joint rates unchanged; compare H_rotated to Q*H_mixed and transformed matrix prediction; no extra body sum
excluded_physics: armature or virtual reflected rotor inertia not added; no independent massmatrix/plant/dynamic verification
failure_policy: preserve original source/trace/counters; stop, no rerun, new threshold or expanded budget
